in_marathi.name: Anagna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anagna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Anagna means 'newborn' in Sanskrit language. This name is derived from the root words 'an' meaning new and 'agna' meaning born. It is a beautiful name for a baby girl, signifying the joy and excitement of a new life. In Hindu culture, the name Anagna is often given to a baby girl born in the auspicious lunar month of Ashada or Chaitra, which is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
